title: Husband Kisses Wife Goodbye After Poisoning Her Shake

beats.description: Dramatic opening audio snippets of Angela's sudden illness and Jim's suspicious behavior, followed by title and case introduction.
Establishes the March 6 timeline, Jim and Angela's morning routine, initial symptoms after workout, and first hospital visit.
Explores marital history: past infidelity, prior drugging incident, recent Seeking.com affair, and growing tension between the couple.
Angela's condition worsens, leading to a second hospitalization. Jim's detached behavior and odd text messages raise family suspicions.
Office manager discovers potassium cyanide package, confronts Jim, and alerts hospital staff. Police are called and begin investigating.
Jim is arrested for first-degree murder. Interrogation reveals his 'she asked for it' defense, while police uncover financial motives and jailhouse plots.
Digital forensics expose search history for undetectable poisons, arsenic delivery, and a reconstructed timeline of multiple poisoning attempts.
Trial proceedings, jury rejection of defense, guilty verdict on all counts, and final sentencing to life without parole.
